Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.startdescription: 'St Mihail's Coffin. Got an idea what 'St Mihail' might be. Don't think we want him gettin out. Don't think so at all. Need to look up some seals and things.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.startdescription: 'Spose if one happened to be the sort who happened to know anything about nyctodromy or, you know, anything, might wonder about being locked up, might wonder what sort of information might… mislead the authorities. Not mislead. Discourage. Put off the scent. Not that there's a scent to put. Sort of thing. Safe side.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.label: On the Endless Guest
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.startdescription: 'Bureau's got Hobson in a box, they say. Bureau wouldn't know a box from a box-room, say I. Ha ha! Box-room! Box-room. As you were. Thought I'd pop over to Kraków, make sure everything's properly sealed. Just want to get my introrcisms straight first. (Box-room!)' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.startdescription: 'Not going back to Miah. Said that already. But that rose that poor feller died for. Black and white one, you see? Rings a bell, tickles a nerve, taps on the old brain-pan…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.label: On the Other Horizon
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.startdescription: 'Fair nyctodromist, don't you know? Fair to middling. Know my way up and down the Bounds. Ys is something else. Need a good book on something else.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dagma.startdescription: 'Going to have a little look into it for a friend, call her K, don't call her K, forget about the friend. Follow new avenues, sort of thing.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=rose> as their <sprite name=rose> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.startdescription: 'For the un-stuffing effort, I'm going to have to read up on protections.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.startdescription: 'There's laws and laws and Laws. One of the Laws is that there can only be so many Long in the world. It's mostly much higher ranks than me enforcing that one. Much higher. But I've been asked to look into it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.startdescription: 'Hoping I can find something relevant in the collection. Course, a lot of things might be relevant.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.startdescription: 'Boss sat me down and explained 'Lyterion' to me. And 'Pan'. You know I got into bleeding grammar school on the bleeding strength of my bleeding Greek? Bleeding scholarship. Never mind. Let's see what you've got on all this.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.startdescription: 'Anyone builds something important, there's always someone trying to break into it or blow it up. That's the job. Funny to see a pack of vicars getting involved with something like that, though. Spose it's what they call 'doctrinal differences'. Here to look into that.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.dougl.startdescription: ''Open'. Is he just, y'know, opened up? Or is he likely to be opening on to something else? ' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.startdescription: 'I've been asked to conduct… might be an exorcism, might be more. I need to make sure I get this one right.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.startdescription: 'There is something within them that opens their eyes to the allure of the lower skies - something that seeks to change them. I must know how to quell it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.startdescription: ''Law's touch is lighter than we know'. When we invoke the Thunderskin, there can be unexpected consequences in the kingdoms of the lower skies…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.startdescription: 'I'm more interested in the therapeutic angle than the artistic one. Although there is something here that, shall we say, tugs at the coat-tail of my thoughts.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.startdescription: 'I've already missed his funeral, but I've commissioned a memorial composition for him. I'm hoping that it can be played on this device of his… but there are ramifications to invoking the powers of the lower skies that I must understand first. ' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.ehsan.startdescription: 'They always think that all of us know everything. That a Lantern-long understands duendrazones, a labhite understands hill-children… but all of us are a mystery to all of us. And this one is a mystery to me.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frank.label: On the Sanctuary Draught
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frank.startdescription: '…gone into the ocean. One last toast, the Prince of Wines and the… not that Lord Bancroft has ever required inspiration. But will you… ?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frank.label: On the Feasting Few
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frank.startdescription: '…understand the hungers they shared. Eternity's gift, and Eternity is generous when…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frank.label: On Knot and Tangle
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frank.startdescription: '…recall to me the matter of blood, which I will never shed again this side of the sea, nor beneath the governance of the wind…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.startdescription: 'Labhites are rare. Fallen labhites, rarer still. If Abecassis continues to change - what will he become?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.startdescription: 'The Obliviates long ago retreated to Port Noon, across the Western Sea. But I hear some of these new cults swearing an 'Ivory Oath' - very like the 'Ivory Chain' of the Obliviates. I'd like to look into other similarities. Illumination, Mansus references, solar doctrines.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.startdescription: 'The shapes reported in the clouds of the West - I've heard of them - or I've seen them in my dreams - or both. I must be certain where my dreams end and where history begins.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.startdescription: 'These blindness, these revelations, in Messana… there is something familiar about them. I have the sense of a coming resolution.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.startdescription: 'I can provide what they need. But some of their requests have piqued my curiosity. I would like to refresh my memory on the, hm, 'solar context'.' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.startdescription: ''The wings to Glory rising now return; the sights we're given are the sights we've earned'. I hope I understand its meaning correctly. But I must confirm for myself.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale>  as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.label: On the Sandalwood Saint
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.frase.startdescription: 'I have some influence in Strasbourg - through my business interests, you know. I can apply that influence here - but to what end, I am not sure.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=scale> as their <sprite name=scale> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.startdescription: 'I have a great many thoughts on this vault matter. A great many. I have not yet resolved upon a particular course. I am here to make a preliminary survey of the relevant literature.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.startdescription: 'I would like to determine which gifts will be most in keeping with the opera's subject matter…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.startdescription: 'When the production fails - and it will - I wish to take full advantage of the situation. Do not concern yourself with the details. I have all the details at my command.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.startdescription: 'Zidane made use of some unusual materials. If I am to salvage the work, I must understand their properties better.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.startdescription: 'I have a general idea of what the Royal Endeavour entails, of course, but I would like to refresh my understanding of a few minor details.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.hokob.startdescription: 'I require information on genealogies. Or cuisine. Or related subjects…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.julia.label: On the Counterfeit Memory
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.julia.startdescription: '…what I read, but it will be significant that I have read it. If it were only written, then only the Black Flower…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.julia.label: On the Midnight Twin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.julia.startdescription: '…there will always be voids in my understanding. To seek to fill them all - that would be to submit to Eternity. But I haunt the questions which remain as a ghost haunts a much-loved…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.julia.label: On the Softer Frost
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.julia.startdescription: '…the words I wrote will always be those words, I wrote, then. Writing my final edition - it changed a great deal, but not that. So with the words of others. But if I read them - even re-read them…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.startdescription: 'I have sisters in the clouds above the Evening Isles. I think the monks of St Tentreto would know to avoid their attentions. And so I think there must be something else up there - something new, or old. I should inform myself before I travel to the Isles...' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.startdescription: 'Persons of some interest to me will attend also. It is important that I be seen at my best. I am looking for a very particular inspiration…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> or Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.startdescription: 'On the first night, there will be some catastrophe. I want to prepare so perfectly for that catastrophe. And, in the event it might not occur, well, I wish to be prepared perfectly for that possibility also.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]
